title: A pinned NP-complete witness threshold language with all positive slices
claims: One witness-threshold language is NP-complete and admits an explicit polynomial-time reduction of SAT in every fixed positive unary request-count slice.
Every measured polynomially bounded verifier admits an unconditional NP verifier for a unary threshold on distinct accepted witnesses.
The conditional machine enumerates exactly the unary-budgeted prefix of distinct witnesses in lexicographic order.
The ranked witness variants return a shortest or lexicographically first witness, with an explicit failure output.
The measured directed pruner preserves each sparse-consistent last-true boundary.
The bounded truth-table hypotheses imply P = NP.
The exact unconditional inclusion P subset NP checks independently.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned exact-statement checker when the reference checkout is available and otherwise report unavailability.
